name: playwright-guardrails
description: Playwright migration guardrails: canonical Playwright framework rules and review checklist, canonical contract and locator-map shapes, and six single-role sibling sub-agents that load those sources into their own context (a suite planner, a contract drafter, a live-DOM locator probe, a deterministic spec writer, a reviewer, and a runtime test runner), plus a /migrate orchestrator skill that drives them in order, to keep test migrations to Playwright, from any source framework, consistent and checkable.
